common.noProject: Choose a project to see its work.

states.errorSentence: Compass could not read {what}. Check your connection, then try again.
states.offlineEmpty: Nothing is saved on this device yet. Connect once to download your work.

signIn.title: Sign in to Compass
signIn.sentence: Use the email your organization or engagement invited.
signIn.linkSent: Check {email} for a sign-in link. It opens Compass.
signIn.invalid: That email and password do not match. Check both, or use an email link.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an email address such as name@example.com.
signIn.network: Compass cannot reach the server. Connect to a network, then sign in.
signIn.identity: Compass could not read your {step}. Try again, or ask your organization to check your invitation.

denial.role: Your role does not include this in Compass. Ask your organization if you need it.
denial.capability: Your role on this project does not allow this. Ask your supervisor to grant it.
denial.notActiveTitle: Your engagement is not active yet
denial.notActive: This opens when your engagement becomes Active. Finish onboarding in Gateway.
denial.closed: Compass access ended when your engagement completed. Money and documents stay in Gateway.

sync.offline: You're offline. Changes save on this device.
sync.authRequired: Sign in again to upload your saved changes.
sync.refreshFailed: Some data did not refresh: {tables}. It refreshes again when you pull down.

queue.title: Offline Queue
queue.empty: Nothing is waiting to upload. Changes you make offline appear here until they upload.
queue.conflictMessage: The server did not take this change. Keep yours to send it again, or keep the server's version.
queue.noServerVersion: The server sent no version of this record.

today.title: Today
today.noShifts: No shifts today. Open shifts appear in Schedule.
today.noDaySheet: No day sheet for today yet.

clock.locationCoarse: Your location is not precise enough yet. Step outside or wait a moment.
clock.locationOff: Location is off. Turn it on in Settings to clock in on site.
clock.unfenced: This project has no geofence; your location is recorded with the punch.
clock.queued: Saved on this device. It uploads when you're back online.
clock.forgotten: Your last shift ran past 16 hours and closed for your supervisor to review.
clock.skewReview: Your phone's clock looks off, so this punch goes to your supervisor to check.

refusal.alreadyIn: You're already clocked in, maybe on another device. Clock out first.
refusal.notClockedIn: You're not clocked in. Clock in first.
refusal.outsideGeofence: Clock in at the venue. Move inside the site boundary, then try again.
refusal.locationUnknown: Compass needs your location to clock in on site. Turn on location, then try again.
refusal.notRostered: You have no accepted shift on this project today. Accept a shift in Schedule first.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty: No upcoming shifts. Open shifts you can claim appear here.

scan.title: Scan
scan.noModes: Your role has nothing to scan in Compass. Your schedule and approvals are in Today.
scan.cameraPermission: Compass needs the camera to scan codes.
scan.hintAsset: Point at an asset tag, serial or GTIN barcode.
scan.hintReceiving: Scan each case. The count runs as you go.
scan.hintCredential: Scan a badge QR code at the access point.
scan.hintLookup: Scan any code to look it up.
scan.chooseZone: Choose the zone you are checking.

deny.unknown: This badge is not on the list for this project.
deny.notYetValid: This badge is not valid yet.
deny.noZoneAccess: This badge does not include this zone.
deny.outsideWindow: This badge is outside its access window for this zone.

scan.invalidChecksum: That barcode did not read correctly. Scan it again.
scan.unsupported: Compass cannot read this kind of code.
scan.intake: Unknown code sent to the desk to identify.
scan.assetNotYours: This item is not assigned to you. Hand it to its custodian.
scan.badgeEmpty: No badge is issued to you for this project yet. Your organization issues badges before the show.
scan.brightness: Brightness is raised while your badge shows.
scan.vendorEmpty: No deliveries booked for you on this project yet. Dock slots appear here once booked.
scan.assignedEmpty: No gear is assigned to you yet. Items appear here when your crew lead hands them over.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.empty: No incidents on this project. Report one the moment it happens.
incidents.locationUnknown: Location not found. Describe where in the title.
incidents.titleHelp: One line, such as Guest fell at Gate B.
incidents.titleMissing: Describe what happened in a few words.
incidents.queued: Report saved. It sends when you're back online.
incidents.dispatchEmpty: No open incidents. New reports appear here within seconds.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.choose: Choose a template to start a walk.
inspections.empty: No inspection templates yet. Your organization adds them in Atlas.
inspections.failNoteMissing: Say what failed so someone can fix it.
inspections.failPhotoMissing: Add a photo of the failure.
inspections.criticalFailures: Critical items failed: {count}. Stop use until they are fixed.
inspections.queued: Inspection saved. It uploads when you're back online.
inspections.signOffOwn: Someone other than the inspector signs off.

show.title: Show
show.empty: No running order for this project today.
show.readOnly: You can follow the running order; cues are called by the stage manager.

kiosk.title: Kiosk
kiosk.setupSentence: Enter the device key shown once when the kiosk was registered in Atlas.
kiosk.deviceKeyInvalid: A device key starts with xkio_. Copy it exactly from Atlas.
kiosk.noMatch: No one matches. Check the spelling, or ask your supervisor to add you.
kiosk.doneQueued: {name}: saved. Your PIN is checked when the kiosk is back online.

refused.pinLocked: This PIN is locked after too many tries. Ask your supervisor to reset it.
refused.deviceRevoked: This kiosk was turned off in Atlas. Ask your supervisor to register it again.
refused.requestInvalid: That punch could not be read. Start again.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: You're all caught up. Approvals and messages appear here.

more.title: More
more.pending: Open Gateway to see {page}. Compass shows it here in a later release.
more.pendingAtlas: Open Atlas to work on {page}. Compass shows it here in a later release.

reference.title: Reference

reference.radioEmpty: No radio plan for this project yet.
reference.mapsEmpty: No venue maps for this project yet.

crew.title: Crew

photo.failed: The photo did not save: {reason}. Try again.

record.sentence: {key} opens on the web for now.

lock.title: Compass is locked

dock.empty: No dock slots on this project today. Slots booked in Atlas appear here.
dock.queued: Check-in saved. It sends now, or when you're back online.

gate.recorded: Arrival saved. It sends now, or when you're back online.
